name: Tella
description: Tella is an all-in-one screen recording and video editing platform for creating, editing, sharing, and analyzing video messages, product demos, tutorials, and other professional videos.

events.d: Create a pre-signed upload destination for video, audio, or image files; specify kind, width, height, and duration.
Runs when a new video is created. Configure the webhook callback URL to receive events.
Create a hosted and editable Tella video from an uploaded video source.
List videos filtered by playlist or tags; set results limit, page cursor, and select response fields.
Search the authenticated user's direct video library by title or indexed transcript sentences.
Retrieve full video details by ID, including transcript, chapters, links, thumbnails, settings, and exports.
Delete a Tella video by specifying its video ID.
Retrieve playlists available to the authenticated user for organization and selection.
Creates a playlist and lets you set name, description, emoji, access level/password, visibility, and search indexing (defaults to off).
Retrieve a playlist and the videos organized within it.
Update a playlist's name, description, group, link scope (password), position, or search engine indexing.
Delete a playlist by ID without removing its videos.
Add an existing video to a playlist.
Remove a video from a playlist without deleting the video itself.
Create a playlist group with a name, optional emoji, and visibility (personal or team).
List playlist groups with an optional visibility filter (e.g., public or private).
List all tags in your Tella account.
